updates.closure_rationale: The original maintenance/HSEM adapter and later disabled-cache boot lifecycle are real scoped implementations. Neither supplies the required cacheable shared-line linker/MPU/cold-start integration. That author mechanism is now being implemented as a distinct additive successor; physical H745/cache/DMA qualification remains separate.
remaining_author_work: Integrate the selected cacheable shared line into exact board linker/MPU/cold-start configuration and separately qualify silicon errata and physical DMA/cache traces; this is not inferred from code generation.
evidence_limits: Author-assisted finite executions are not independent learner assessment or absolute mastery.
See receipt source fingerprints and individual command scope; physical hardware is never inferred from models or QEMU.
H745 MMIO adapters are compiled/linked, not executed on silicon; register traces and digital cuts are models.
H745 flash has32-byte data/ECC program words; the earlier4/8-byte bit-clear model is not a physical target contract.
